newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline, diesel diffs steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline, diesel diffs steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel differentials were steady on Thursday in Chicago and Group Three, leaving prices to track the NYMEX complex, traders said.

Traders were monitoring an Illinois circuit court hearing that could shut the 80,515 barrel per day Clark Refining and Marketing refinery at Blue Island, Ill. The hearing was expected to continue into Friday.
State regulators said the facility was being operated unsafely following an explosion and fire on Saturday that rocked the neighborhood around the plant.

Clark defended its safety record at the Chicago-area refinery and said it would be inappropriate to shut the facility over safety concerns until federal regulators had completed an investigation into the weekend blaze.
The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency probe could take several weeks, Clark attorneys said in a hearing in Cook County Circuit Court.
Unleaded gasoline for late-October deliveries was bid 0.25 cent a gallon under NYMEX November unleaded in Chicago and even with the print in Group Three.
Low sulphur diesel for late-October deliveries was talked even to 0.25 cent a gallon over NYMEX November heating oil in Chicago and 4.0/4.25 cents over the print in Group Three.
High sulphur diesel for all October timings was bid 1.75 cent under the print in Chicago and even with the print in Group Three.
Jet/kero was talked 2.0/2.25 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 2.75/3.0 cents over in Group Three.
